skill.name: code-to-music
skill.description: Creates original instrumental compositions with Python, music21, mido, FluidSynth, and pydub, then renders and validates downloadable MP3 audio.
skill.summary: Compose and render original MIDI-based instrumental music as MP3.
skill.author: Cam10001110101

security_audit.summary: Most scanner alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, MIDI variable names, music terminology, and reference URLs. Real concerns are system-wide installer execution, unguarded deletion of output-adjacent temporary files, and guidance to ignore Python environment errors.

remediation.suggestion: Request confirmation before apt operations, use a virtual environment for Python packages, pin dependency versions, and avoid upgrading the host pip.
Use unique temporary paths, reject collisions with existing files, and delete only files created by the current process.
Check every installer exit status and report failures. Remove the claim that externally managed environment errors indicate successful installation.

content.value_statement: Creating original instrumental music requires composition, MIDI, rendering, and quality checks. This skill guides that workflow and produces downloadable MP3 files.
actual_capabilities: Guides algorithmic creation of original melodies, chords, rhythms, dynamics, and structured arrangements.
Selects traditional or electronic workflows based on genre, instruments, tempo, and sound requirements.
Assigns General MIDI instruments, percussion channels, velocities, and timing with music21 and mido.
Renders supported music structures through FluidSynth and pydub into downloadable MP3 files.
Checks audio duration, clipping, silence, loudness, dynamic range, and abrupt volume changes.
limitations: The workflow supports instrumental music only, without lyrics, vocals, or real-time playback.
Output quality depends on installed soundfonts, FluidSynth, FFmpeg, and compatible Python packages.
General MIDI rendering does not provide professional studio recording, advanced synthesis, mixing, or mastering quality.
Some documented inventory and transformation helper scripts are absent, so that advanced workflow is incomplete.

use_cases.title: Create Prototype Soundtracks
use_cases.description: Produce original instrumental cues for games, demos, and interactive prototypes without requiring a digital audio workstation.

use_cases.title: Teach Music Through Code
use_cases.description: Demonstrate scales, chord progressions, MIDI instruments, rhythm, and arrangement through audible examples.

use_cases.title: Produce Background Music
use_cases.description: Create original instrumental MP3 tracks for presentations, videos, podcasts, and internal media.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Piano Piece
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-second original piano piece in C major at 90 BPM. Render it as MP3 and report validation results.

prompt_templates.title: Arrange a Jazz Trio
prompt_templates.prompt: Compose a 60-second original jazz piece for piano, acoustic bass, and drums. Use clear sections, balanced velocities, and a 120 BPM tempo.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Electronic Track
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an original deep house track with syncopated bass, layered percussion, warm pads, and a breakdown. Render and validate a 90-second MP3.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Orchestral Arc
prompt_templates.prompt: Compose an original orchestral piece with introduction, development, climax, and resolution. Assign MIDI programs, control dynamics, render the MP3, and correct validation issues.

output_examples.input: Create a calm 30-second piano piece in C major at 90 BPM.
output_examples.output: Produced a downloadable piano MP3 with a clear opening, gentle development, resolved ending, and passing audio validation results.

output_examples.input: Make a 60-second jazz trio cue with piano, bass, and drums.
output_examples.output: Produced an original jazz trio MP3 with assigned instruments, balanced velocities, structured sections, and a validation summary.

output_examples.input: Create a 90-second deep house track with a breakdown and drop.
output_examples.output: Produced an electronic MP3 with layered percussion, syncopated bass, warm pads, contrasting sections, and checked audio levels.

best_practices: State the genre, duration, tempo, instruments, mood, and required output format before composition begins.
Use original musical material and request structural variation, balanced velocities, accurate MIDI programs, and complete bar coverage.
Validate the rendered file for duration, clipping, silence, loudness, and dynamic range before delivery.
anti_patterns: Do not request replicas of copyrighted songs, melodies, riffs, beats, or recognizable artist styles.
Do not assume MIDI track numbers or rely on music21 instrument classes alone for final program assignment.
Do not use this workflow for vocals, real-time performance, advanced mastering, or professional studio recording.

faq.question: What audio format does this skill produce?
faq.answer: The documented workflow renders downloadable MP3 files, with temporary MIDI and WAV files used during conversion.

faq.question: Can it create vocals or lyrics?
faq.answer: No. The skill is limited to instrumental, MIDI-based composition and rendered audio.

faq.question: Which music styles are supported?
faq.answer: It provides guidance for electronic, orchestral, classical, jazz, rock, folk, reggae, ambient, and related instrumental styles.

faq.question: What software must be installed?
faq.answer: The workflow requires Python packages, FluidSynth, FFmpeg, and a compatible General MIDI soundfont.

faq.question: Does it validate the finished audio?
faq.answer: Yes. The included validator checks duration, clipping, silence, loudness, dynamic range, and abrupt volume changes.

faq.question: Can it transform an existing MIDI file?
faq.answer: Some utility functions can inspect or filter MIDI data, but documented inventory and transformation helpers are missing from this package.
